description: Charge history for one merchant (case-insensitive substring match on merchant name or description): charge count, total spent, average amount, first and last charge dates, and the matching transactions, newest first. Default window is the last 12 months. Transactions are paginated with limit/offset (default 50, max 200); the totals cover every match. The response includes a `warnings` array of notices about banks that could not contribute (for example, a bank that needs reconnecting), each with a message and, when relevant, a reconnect_url.

account_id.description: Limit results to a specific account. Use an account id returned by list_accounts.

end_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1 to 200). Defaults to 50.

merchant.description: Merchant name or part of it, for example "starbucks".

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging. Defaults to 0. Use with has_more.

start_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 12 months ago.

name: get_merchant_history
title: Merchant Charge History
